name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Aok
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#all-actions) sends an A-OK RF remote code to a remote transmitter. A-OK is used by remote controls for roller shutters, awnings and similar motors on 433MHz and 868MHz.

config_entries.label: Channels
config_entries.description: The 16-bit channel mask to send the command to. Each of the 16 channels on the remote corresponds to one bit of the mask. Multiple bits can be set at once to broadcast the command to multiple receivers.

config_entries.label: Command
config_entries.description: The 1-byte command code to send. Range is 0 to 0xFF.

config_entries.label: Remote ID
config_entries.description: The 24-bit ID of the remote to send as. Range is 0 to 0xFFFFFF.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
